purpose: Admin inspection of an individual GDPR export artifact, its metadata, lifecycle and browser-owned bundle download.
primaryGoal: Look up an artifact by URL-backed ID, monitor its state, inspect evidence and download an available bundle.

dataSources.name: selected GDPR artifact
dataSources.behavior: Query key ['admin','gdpr','exports',id]; enabled only for a nonempty ID; forwards AbortSignal; unwraps data envelope; QUICK stale time; FAST periodic refetch, not in background; retry 1. Polling is unconditional while enabled, including terminal states.
dataSources.contractRisk: The TypeScript artifact interface does not match the registered handler's manifest. Backend exposes byte_count and storage_kind, and no status or format. Neither envelope unwrapping nor camelCase aliasing supplies these missing fields.

dataSources.name: bundle stream
dataSources.behavior: apiUrl builds the browser anchor URL from an encoded artifact ID only when frontend status is complete; no binary XHR. Handler streams local_fs gzip bundles, responds 501 for unsupported storage and 410 for deleted files, and records a download after successful streaming. Deployment availability and audit persistence were not exercised.

components.name: PageLayout / PageContainer
components.role: Existing full-width layout adapter; PageContainer owns header actions, query freshness and retained-source notice.

components.name: AdminSummary / OperationalBrief
components.role: Existing admin adapter to useOperationalMetrics and canonical OperationalBrief. Six selected-artifact measurements; lifecycle timestamps are not workspace analysis dates.

components.name: GDPRLookupPanel
components.role: Controlled ID draft, localized labeled Input, trimmed nonempty Button/Enter activation, provenance and retention hints.

components.name: GDPRArtifactDetails
components.role: Definition list with ID/user/timestamps/checksum, shared CopyButton, local MetaRow and TimeValue; contextual skeleton and empty state.

components.name: GDPRDownloadPanel
components.role: Native download anchor, stream/audit explanation and queued/running/expired/unavailable explanations.

components.name: GDPRLifecyclePanel / Timeline
components.role: Ordered created/completed-or-failed/expiry evidence; uses existing Timeline renderer, not a second timeline.

components.name: Existing primitives and trust owners
components.role: Reuse GlassPanel, Button, Input, CopyButton, typography roles, Skeleton, EmptyState, AlertBanner, DataStateNotice, QueryError, SectionErrorBoundary and FadeIn; deriveDataState owns fatal versus refresh failures.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Anchor manually recreates shared Button chrome, diverging in radius, timing, focus-ring/offset and forced-color styling.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep the single native anchor and download attribute; compose existing exported BUTTON_BASE and BUTTON_VARIANTS.primary with local width/target sizing. Do not nest a Button inside an anchor or create another link-button implementation.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: MetaRow and TimeValue are local presentation helpers, not proved cross-page duplication. All four panels reuse GlassPanel and typography; AdminSummary already centralizes brief rendering.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Retain these bounded helpers unless a separate inventory demonstrates equivalent consumers; no speculative shared metadata renderer is needed.

sourceStrategy: Page detail area stacks then becomes xl:grid-cols-3; metadata spans two columns (page:206-219).
Supporting download/lifecycle panels use one column, sm two columns, xl one column (page:212).
Lookup controls stack then become sm:flex-row; hint splits at lg (GDPRLookupPanel.tsx:31-34).
Metadata is one/md two/2xl three columns, with ID and checksum full-span and break-all (GDPRArtifactDetails.tsx:36-43,75-81).
Download anchor is full-width on narrow screens and auto-width at sm, minimum 44px high (GDPRDownloadPanel.tsx:48).

issues.detail: The flex-1 input wrapper lacks min-w-0; fixed-height lookup Button does not opt into shared wrapLabel. Long localized text and 200% text may pressure the sm horizontal row. Source risk, not observed clipping.
issues.fix: Use existing min-w-0/max-w-full and Button wrapLabel where needed; verify all labels, input and action remain reachable without losing hints.

responsive.viewportTesting: NOT RUN; no browser, mounted container or screenshots inspected.

sourceStrengths: Refresh has localized aria-label and min-h-11; decorative icon is hidden (page:108-116).
Lookup uses labeled shared Input; Enter and Button share trimmed-ID guard (GDPRLookupPanel.tsx:26,35-50).
Artifact details use dl and aria-busy; loading skeleton group is aria-hidden (GDPRArtifactDetails.tsx:23-36).
Download uses one native anchor rather than nested interactive elements (GDPRDownloadPanel.tsx:40-57).
Lifecycle state uses text and icons as well as color (GDPRLifecyclePanel.tsx:34-88).
FadeIn delegates to useMotionPreference and uses initial=false for reduction (FadeIn.tsx:23-35); OS-mode behavior remains unverified.

issues.detail: Caller supplies oldest-first created-to-terminal-to-expiry items but omits Timeline chronology, which defaults to newest-first; inferred accessible start/end bounds are reversed. Caller also leaves the list name generic.
issues.fix: Pass localized lifecycle label and chronology='oldest-first'; use existing summaryBounds when causal events should not imply measured chronological bounds. Preserve event ordering and timestamps.

issues.detail: ID and checksum icon-only CopyButtons both use generic shared 'Copy' names and sm size. sm Button is h-9; 44px target compliance or a spacing exception is not established. Clipboard failures have no caller feedback because withToast and onCopyError are omitted.
issues.fix: Use existing ariaLabel/label props to distinguish copied fields, retain Copied feedback, provide existing toast or manual-copy error recovery, and verify target spacing or increase local target size. Apply equally at line 81.

accessibility.verification: Keyboard operation, focus visibility, screen readers, contrast, forced colors, touch geometry and reduced-motion rendering NOT RUN.

states.initial: No active ID disables query and refresh; lookup stays present; explanatory No artifact selected state (page:58-67,108-113,149-162).
states.loading: With active ID, summary and metadata/download/lifecycle skeletons render; existing artifact prevents skeleton replacement (page:92,192,209-218; panel showLoading guards).
states.empty: No-selection prompt and child metadata/lifecycle EmptyStates exist. A resolved null payload is not validated by the hook; behavior remains unverified, not assumed supported.
states.notFound: Fatal 404 renders Artifact not found guidance; lookup and refresh remain available (page:70,163-172).
states.unsupported: Fatal 503 renders unsupported subsystem notice and suppresses artifact area (page:69,137-147,181).
states.fatalError: Other initial errors render QueryError with retry (page:71,173-180).
states.failedArtifact: artifact.error produces failure alert; lifecycle uses nonblank reason or fallback and suppresses contradictory completed entry for failed status.
states.staleOffline: deriveDataState keeps retained payload on failed or paused refresh; summary labels stale, and PageLayout dataSources mounts DataSourceNotice only with retained data. PageContainer query prop adds freshness. No runtime offline/retry outcome claimed.
states.success: Frontend complete status generates encoded browser-owned download URL. Current backend wire mismatch makes this source gate suspect, not a proved working download.
states.disabled: Lookup disabled on trimmed blank input, refresh disabled without activeId. No busy disabling on an active refetch is declared.

issues.detail: Hook polls every FAST interval regardless of status while enabled; comments at 336-337 and lookup hint claim queued/running-only polling. Page never disables the query after completion.
issues.fix: Reconcile documentation and desired polling lifecycle with the API/query owner after wire contract repair. Preserve the existing key, cancellation, retry and inherited behavior unless an explicitly authorized policy change is tested.

visualIssues.detail: Lifecycle dot palette hardcodes cyan #22d3ee, emerald, rose and amber hex colors outside semantic theme ownership. Dynamic Timeline props do not exempt a saturated fixed feature palette from visual-noise requirements.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing subdued semantic token values through Timeline's current color prop or neutral defaults, keeping distinct labels/icons and all failure/expiry semantics. Do not reset saved theme choices.

visualIssues.detail: Hint background uses fixed white at 2% opacity and a fixed cyan decorative icon; lifecycle header also uses text-cyan-300 at GDPRLifecyclePanel.tsx:96. These are theme-independent accent/white traces, not an observed pure-white page or measured contrast failure.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing neutral surface/border and muted text tokens for informational decoration; reserve semantic color for actual artifact state.

architectureIssues.detail: Registered Get returns the service Artifact alias directly (handler:50-65; service:27,75-91). Backend Artifact has byte_count, storage_kind, export_job_id, vehicle_id, storage_path, downloaded_at and download_count but no status, format, bytes, storage, user_id, completed_at or error (artifact_repo.go:54-65). The frontend casts this response to GDPRExportArtifact. Consequently source logic expects a missing status to permit downloading and missing measurement fields for summary. This is a verified source contract mismatch, not an executed request failure.
architectureIssues.fix: API/type integration owner must establish the authoritative manifest/job contract and expose real status/format/lifecycle evidence or adapt callers to genuinely available fields. Preserve existing UI capabilities and all backend manifest data; never fabricate complete status, zero bytes, queue progress or new backend capabilities.

architectureIssues.detail: Editable and URL-supplied IDs are interpolated directly into the metadata request path, unlike the encoded download ID. Slashes, question marks or hashes can alter path/query meaning.
architectureIssues.fix: Reuse encodeURIComponent for the path segment or validate the real artifact-ID contract; preserve URL-driven selection and query identity, and provide honest invalid-ID guidance without guessing UUID-only backend enforcement.

architectureIssues.detail: All four feature panels import typography directly from @/components/ui/Typography, although other UI imports already use the category barrel.
architectureIssues.fix: Consolidate typography imports through @/components/ui in all four panels; do not change shared internal import policy.

architectureIssues.detail: formatRelative emits literal English relative strings and returns 'just now' for all future instants because negative seconds satisfy seconds < 60. Selected expiry summary at page:103 and future lifecycle expiry time at GDPRLifecyclePanel.tsx:85 use this helper. Absolute expiry details remain present, but the relative label can misrepresent future expiry.
architectureIssues.fix: Shared date owner should use the existing localization/locale policy for past and future relative instants, retaining invalid/missing placeholders and absolute timestamp evidence. Callers must not create a separate per-feature relative-time formatter.

priority.reason: Source-proved API/type mismatch affects status, measurements and download eligibility; resolve integration ownership before accepting a cosmetic modernization.

Reuse Button chrome, fix lifecycle accessible chronology and specific copy-action feedback.
Replace fixed feature palette/white decoration and typography deep imports.
Validate responsive labels and shared localized future-relative dates centrally.

requiredSharedChanges.detail: Typed response differs from directly returned backend manifest; metadata ID encoding and polling documentation also belong to this same owner.
requiredSharedChanges.fix: Coordinate authoritative typed artifact/job data repair without a speculative second hook, fabricated lifecycle fields or policy changes.

requiredSharedChanges.fix: Extend the canonical helper under its bounded owner, preserving past output semantics, absolute-date fallback and locale/timezone policy; verify affected consumers before adoption.

competingImplementations.fix: Reuse BUTTON_BASE/BUTTON_VARIANTS.primary already exported at web\src\components\ui\index.ts:1.

dataBehavior: URL id is the authoritative selection, not duplicated server state.
Keep typed query key, cancellation, retry, interval/background policy and envelope handling; repair real contract rather than invent data.
